# Cross-cohort results (seed-mean AUROC; reversed test = shortcut-reversed; auto-generated)

Arms prefixed U- use the generic, artifact-agnostic overlay library. `rev (clean)`. † = gaming (correlated-test AUROC < reversed − 0.02: the shortcut is flipped, not removed; excluded by pre-registration).

min(rev, corr) is a post-hoc secondary summary that penalises both shortcut use and shortcut flipping.

Label needs: erm/mask/U-mte/U-mte_protect: none; balanced/dfr/leace/*_balanced/*_dfr: image-level artifact labels.
